sloka: तस्य धर्म कृत आदेशा वयम् अन्ये च पार्थिवः ।चरामो वसुधाम् कृत्स्नाम् धर्म संतानम् इच्छवः ॥४-१८-९॥
transliteration: tasya dharma kṛta ādeśā vayam anye ca pārthivaḥ ।carāmo vasudhām kṛtsnām dharma saṁtānam icchavaḥ ॥4-18-9॥

translations.english: 'Following his command, in confirmity with dharma we and the other kings also move all over the entire world desirous of promoting dharma.
